title: Compile fixed GUI guard sources and verify managed-only helper behaviour

inputs.role: Fixed candidate C# compiled and managed methods tested only; Guard.Run and all Win32 invocation methods forbidden
Original v3 source compiled only for pure Evaluate admission parity; never executed as guard
Corrected fixed source-only Add-Type and managed validation entry; no engine or Guard.Run
Read-only enum-fix source provenance; not authority or native adoption

requirements: Interpret this task solely as a fixed-source, no-engine interface-acceptance auxiliary test in the already accepted Words and Perils focused scope. It is not GUI deployment or permission to run GUI, and it cannot update trusted policy/pins. If current local accepted scope or session authority does not support this exact managed-only test, publish blocked and do not execute or find another route.

Before claim and safe substeps use fresh immutable main/strict CONTROL/remote STOP and the existing trusted local STOP latch, repository identity/source/worker permissions, repository-wide exclusive single-writer lock and durable ID/raw-SHA terminal dedupe. Reconcile existing owner/CLAIM/ACK and task010 terminal cleanup; do not steal claims, rerun task010 or clear a protected STOP. Create the existing unique CLAIM by expected-head non-force CAS and verify ownership/readback before work.

Verify all four fixed inputs at base_commit by raw bytes, size, SHA256 and Git blob SHA. Assemble only the three pinned source files at their project_path inside a newly created owned random disposable tree; keep TEST_INPUT_MANIFEST.json read-only. Verify canonical containment, no overlap/reparse/symlink and original sources unchanged. Review the fixed harness before execution; task JSON never supplies an arbitrary shell string.

Use the existing installed PowerShell through the established local owner execution tools only. Start one fresh owned source-only PowerShell process with NoProfile/NonInteractive and the fixed File entry, with TEMP/TMP redirected into a verified fresh task-owned temp subtree. The harness itself performs only Add-Type of the two pinned C# files and managed validation. Missing compiler/runtime means blocked; do not install dependencies or change system settings.

Never call Guard.Run, either guard wrapper, CreateProcessW/ResumeThread, engine guard runtime tests, Godot, Main, GUI, capture, rendering, engine help/version, services or network/model requests. No actual Godot executable is required, opened or created by this harness. Compile-only DLLs are ephemeral test artifacts, never deployed to trusted guard locations.

Preserve all stricter existing physical budget/reserve and safe host admission requirements; use the established bounded owned-process execution path with at most 120 seconds and 65536 aggregate stdout/stderr bytes. On timeout, output overflow, cancellation or other actual rejection stop, clean only verified owned processes/paths and preserve failed evidence. Do not invent a runner/service or use Guard.Run/wrapper to achieve these bounds. If no compliant existing host path is available, report blocked.

Capture actual host PID plus process creation time, unique owner runID, lock ownership, start/end, actual exit code, complete retained stdout/stderr and output-limit outcome. Require actual JSON status passed with actual checks count, engine_invocations=0, native_guard_run_calls=0, win32_equivalence=NOT_TESTED. Scan all stdout/stderr for SCRIPT ERROR/ERROR/WARNING and failure text; expected caught negative assertions must not be relabeled as execution evidence. Record actual managed count, never reuse cloud 52/53/154 scores.

Rehash all compiled/test source files before and after. Confirm host exited and no owned process/reader remains. Keep the repository lock through safe result publication and release in finally. Harness random temp cleanup is allowed only under the task-owned TEMP tree after containment/no-reparse/owned-process checks; preserve diagnostic evidence before removing owned temp paths. Never touch old saves, existing releases/candidates, global temp or unrelated processes.

Run the source-only harness at most once under this task. On real failure or unsupported scope/permissions, preserve raw evidence and stop; no same-ID retry or source/expectation/catch changes. Compilation/managed success does not establish Win32 Job/AvailPhys/cleanup equivalence, GUI admission, actual frames/screenshots/video, formal adoption, Main or full game acceptance.

Publish only new task candidate_root and exact result_root with existing two-phase, fresh-main single-parent non-force CAS and exact remote byte/hash readback. Do not change inbox/CONTROL/STOP/protocol/schema/trusted pins, originals, README/Actions/history/visibility/permissions. Sanitize personal paths, account data and secrets from outputs before public upload. Candidate adopted remains false.
preserve: v1 and v2 source candidates and exact original v3 bytes
Current trusted protocol/schema pins, native guard entry, local safety/STOP state
All task010 and other terminal scores, claims, ledger and artifacts
Blank README, no Actions, production/default and repository history/visibility
out_of_scope: Any Guard.Run/wrapper/native guard runtime test or engine/GUI/service invocation
GUI deployment/adoption or treating compilation as GUI run permission
OS/security/permission/connection/pin changes, new credentials, dependency installation
Repeat of task010 or old headless gameplay tests
Real user data, keys, player saves, arbitrary command execution

publication.phases: A: immutable sanitized compile/managed source/output evidence and ARTIFACTS.json; B: actual RESULT/SUMMARY referring to A commit. Existing expected-head force=false CAS and exact remote readback.
